- Human annotators are asked two questions: one on predicate match and one on character relation similarity.
Two questions: (1) predicate match between generation and reference; (2) character relation similarity between generation and reference, rated on a 1‑5 scale.

The first is "Do the predicates in the generation match the predicates in the reference?" The second is "When multiple characters are mentioned as being related in some way in the generated recap, are those same characters mentioned as being related in some way in the reference?"
